doors.why: V2: Saltreach Recovery Bay, white dome with the blue cross

t: PORT SALTREACH DOCKS. Sunny skies, clear water, and the best fish pies in the Kessler system.
Sailor: Welcome to Port Saltreach! The fog rolls in every morning, thick as chowder.
Dockhand: Helix boats were circling the harbor again last night. White coats, no flags. Shady.
Swimmer: Hydro types are everywhere here. Bring something with Volt moves and they'll fold fast.
Net-mender: The big dome up top is the Recovery Bay. Rest your Alienmon there, it's free.
Diver: Tall weeds on the coral bars hide wild Alienmon. The shallows are full of them.
Old salt: Thalassa's rings throw rainbows on the water at noon. Best view's from the lighthouse.
Fishmonger: Fresh catch! ...No, you can't catch it with a Stasis Pod. It's a fish. It's dead.
Sailor: Lighthouse is east, past the market. The old Captain's Log is still up there.
Shopper: Stock up on Stasis Pods at the docks shop. A weakened Alienmon is easier to catch.
Mechanic: Captain Marsh's tower relays signals for the whole system. Or it did, till Helix came.
Traveller: Keepers guard the Relay Towers. Win and they hand you a Signal Shard.
Harbor guard: Trainers on the routes will spot you if you walk into their line of sight. Be ready.
Storyteller: They say Anchorath sleeps under the sea arch, and the tide turns when it dreams.
Nurse: Welcome to the Saltreach Recovery Bay. Your Alienmon will be shipshape in no time.
Sailor: I come here after every storm. Even my Alienmon get seasick, believe it or not.
Clerk: Ahoy! Pods, potions, rope, bait. Everything a Linker needs before the coral route.
Shopper: Status cures are worth it out on the islands. Wild bites sting more than you'd think.
Deckhand: Captain Marsh is upstairs. Helix ripped the core right out of this tower. She's furious.
First mate: The Captain fights with the tide behind her. Volt types might give you a chance.
Keeper's aide: The stairs up top lead out onto the coral sand bars. Watch for the tide.
Lamp tender: This light guided the fishing fleet for a hundred years. Helix ships ignore it.
Beachcomber: The coral bars connect at low tide. Hop the bridges and you'll stay dry.
Swimmer: My Alienmon love the shallows. Low-level ones, sure, but they never stop splashing.
Castaway: Saw an old wreck off the south rocks. Nobody's dared dive it yet.
Sailor: Harbor Tower is past the sea arch. Captain Marsh doesn't go easy on anyone.
Researcher: Readings spike under the arch at night. Whatever sleeps there is enormous.
Pilgrim: Walk softly here. The islanders leave shells at the shrines so Anchorath sleeps on.
Lookout: Helix divers were poking around the cove. I chased them off with a bucket.

notes: Thalassa: both interiors hang off the arrival docks 052 (cross dome = bay, awning dome = shop); 053 has a second cross dome whose door is left blocked. Harbor Tower 1F (060): the centre pier (7-8,7-10) dead-ends at a pool, so the climb goes up the side bridges (3-4,8)/(11-12,8); I let the tile under each hanging banner (3,6-7)/(12,6-7) count as the bridge's continuation to the anchor decks. Sea Arch Cove (059): the art has no continuous land link between the west shore and the east shore/tower exit, so the middle dock is joined by two short water hops, (11-12,13) west of the dock and (16-17,11) east of it (the docks NPC line says "jump the short gaps between piers"). A boat/ferry or a drawn plank would be nicer: owner decision. 2F (061) climbs via side stairs (4-5,7-8)/(10-11,7-8).
